name: ai-token-usage
title: AI Token Usage
description: Token usage and cost for Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex per day, project and session, plus Claude subscription limits and OpenRouter credits. Requires tokscale.
author: asm0dey

commands.name: usage
commands.title: AI Token Usage
commands.subtitle: tokscale
commands.description: Show token usage, cost, limits and per-project sessions.

commands.name: refresh
commands.title: Refresh AI Token Usage
commands.subtitle: AI Token Usage
commands.description: Refresh token usage and limits in the background every 5 minutes.

preferences.name: claudeMonthlyPrice
preferences.title: Claude Subscription Price (USD/month)
preferences.description: Optional. What you pay for Claude per month, e.g. 100. Shows this month's Claude usage at list prices as a multiple of it.

preferences.name: openrouterApiKey
preferences.title: OpenRouter API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Shows OpenRouter credits and key limit. Leave empty to use the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable.
